title: Quenched Citrusy French Chicken Thighs Pasta
description:
A French Provençal-inspired dish featuring crispy chicken thighs, a zesty citrus sauce, and a light pasta water emulsion
Served on a cedar plank for a rustic touch.
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken thighs until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the lemon zest and cook for another minute.
Add the white wine and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Add the lemon juice and cook until heated through.
Add the pasta water to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until slightly thickened, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine.
Stir in the parmesan cheese until melted and well combined.
Return the chicken to the skillet and toss to combine with the pasta and sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the chicken and pasta to a cedar plank and garnish with chopped parsley.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
